experiment.name: invalid_inputs
experiment.setup: let case-id replicate-id set-defaults set replicate-id case-id set num-nodes 80 if case-id = 1 [set legal-response-time 0] if case-id = 2 [set platform-speed 101] if case-id = 3 [set targeting-mode "default"] if case-id = 4 [set demand-kappa -1] if case-id = 5 [set legal-tpr 101] let rejected? false carefully [setup] [set rejected? true set network-type error-message] if not rejected? [error "Invalid input was unexpectedly accepted."] reset-ticks
